name: Drill: dig a staircase down and come back up
context: Movement practice underground. Needs a pickaxe; torches help. Survival world, wherever the player is now; never assume coordinates, find things with mc_find_blocks. Never dig the block under your own feet or straight down; dig staircases or side tunnels. Avoid lava and deep water (mc_mine allowFluids only for sand/gravel at shores). Do not break blocks of player-built structures.

steps.name: dig a staircase 8 blocks down
steps.goal: From where you stand on dry land, dig a staircase going down 8 blocks: mc_dig direction=<north/south/east/west> stairs=true length=8. If it stops early (water, lava, no floor), read why and continue in another direction from where you are. Place a torch on the stairs every 4 steps if you have torches.
steps.verify: mc_observe shows your feet at least 7 blocks lower than where this step started, standing in your own staircase.

steps.name: return to the surface
steps.goal: Walk back up your staircase to where you started (mc_goto to the top step, give its y; the staircase was dug in one straight line). Then mc_observe to confirm you are back on the surface.
steps.verify: your y is back within 1 block of where the staircase started (compare with the start of the previous step).
